title: NEKOBEDS
body:
**_Sweet Dreams with the Catgirls_**

Transform your sleeping quarters into a catgirl paradise! This pack replaces the default bed textures with beautiful, high-quality images of your favorite NEKOPARA characters - from Chocola and Vanilla to Coconut, Azuki, Maple, Cinnamon, and more. Each bed features adorable maid outfits and charming expressions, turning every rest into a cozy, anime-filled moment.

_Perfect for fans of catgirls. Time to make your Minecraft bedroom a little sweeter!_
